Fed meeting recap: Powell to stay on board

summary: April 29 2026: FOMC voted 8-4 to hold benchmark fed funds rate at 3.5%-3.75%. Unusual 4-dissenting votes, last seen October 1992. Inflation elevated partly from Middle East energy price spike. Markets price zero rate cuts in 2026, one 25bp cut in Dec 2027. Powell staying on Fed Board despite Trump legal challenges.
